summary: After editing the inventory, run `sudo ./setup.sh`, or as a non-root sudo user `ANSIBLE_BECOME_METHOD='sudo' ANSIBLE_BECOME=True ./setup.sh`. To add mesh nodes later, add them to the inventory and rerun `setup.sh`; containerized installs use the installation playbook instead.
questions: How do I run the AAP RPM installer?
Run setup.sh as non-root with sudo
How do I add nodes to automation mesh after install?

answer_card.title: Run the RPM installer
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo ./setup.sh
# non-root user with sudo:
ANSIBLE_BECOME_METHOD='sudo' ANSIBLE_BECOME=True ./setup.sh
```
Add nodes later by editing the inventory and rerunning `setup.sh`.
